Priya Nair: Hey folks — last-minute ask. I have a family thing and won't be able to cover my Sun 18:00-22:00 UTC oncall block. Can someone pick it up? I'm reachable by SMS but can't handle escalations. :wave:
Mateo Ruiz: I can take 18:00-19:45, but I have the 19:00 staging rollout. Is that okay?
Priya Nair: Thanks Mateo — that's fine. The rollout is expected but it's small. See runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/sun-evening (short checklist in the thread below).
Alex Kim: I can do 19:45-22:00 after my QA call. @Mateo want to hand to me at 19:40? I can be on phone for escalations.
Mateo Ruiz: Yep I can hand off at 19:40. I'll stay until 20:00 in case the rollout needs immediate follow-up.
Jenna Park: If you want a second pair of eyes during the rollout I can shadow 18:55-19:15 and watch perf dashboards. Otherwise I'll be offline after 20:30.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: model/embedding-v2 -> staging at 19:00 UTC. Monitors: perf-alerts, error-rate, kv-cache-errors.
Priya Nair: TL;DR of runbook I followed for this model rollout:
- pre-roll checks: infra green, drift < 0.5%
- at 19:00 kick: /scripts/rollout.sh model/embedding-v2 staging
- watch: latency p95 and error-rate (dash link above)
- fallback: pin to embedding-v1 and abort rollout if error-rate > 1% for 5m
- on escalation: page SRE team + post status in #incidents
(I'm adding these to the runbook now.)
Alex Kim: Quick Q — any KV cache bump expected during rollout? Could blow up tail latency.
Priya Nair: There might be a transient KV cache miss spike for ~30s. If you see sustained tail > 2x baseline, abort and fallback.
Mateo Ruiz: Noted. I'll run the small smoke test after the deploy and report in thread.
Jenna Park: I'll stay on perf for the first 15m after deploy and call if I see regressions.
Alex Kim: Confirmed for 19:40 handoff and I'll take escalations through 22:00. My mobile is +1-415-555-0148 if you need immediate reach.
Priya Nair: Huge thanks everyone. I'll drop a short note in the schedule so ops knows the switch. :pray:
Mateo Ruiz: marked in my calendar. I'll post the quick smoke results here after 19:05.
deploy-bot: Reminder: health-checks enabled, automatic rollback on critical errors = true.
Alex Kim: Got it. See you all tomorrow.
Jenna Park: Good luck — ping if anything weird pops up.
